subject: Persist Master Command Prompt Autocode as the Codex Cloud direct-session contract
batchGoal: Make the user-provided master command prompt autocode template the canonical repo contract for Codex Cloud coding requests and adaptive autocoding batches.
scope: Startup contract docs, reusable template artifact, adaptive Codex Cloud autocoding prompts, verification tests, approval gates, and completion reporting.
constraints: Use OpenClaw + MASTER batching for this task.
Do not manually implement outside the OpenClaw plan/execute/verify/FIX -> RETEST/next-batch cycle.
RUNAROUND BREAKER MODE must activate before another implementation prompt when two FIX -> RETEST loops fail or the same user-facing goal remains broken after two prompts.

No deploy, publish, secrets, database writes or migrations, destructive filesystem actions, paid provider actions, production reverse-proxy changes, or live external submissions without owner approval.
Do not log tokens or secrets.
Do not raw-upload local private state.
Granite first; Aider at most ONE surgical round per task, only if Granite still fails after its raw FIX->RETEST attempts; then RUNAROUND BREAKER.

Seed verify: before any Granite call, the runner confirms the task seed (current file) and objective appear verbatim in the Type A prompt; if either is missing it fails loudly (status seed_verify_fail) and does not call Granite or Aider.
sequencingRule: Execute batches in listed order. Do not start batch N+1 until batch N has fully passed verification.
failPolicy: Run targeted FIX -> RETEST loops for the current batch using the smallest failing/changed-file command first; cap full verification loops to avoid repeated repo-wide checks unless targeted evidence shows broader risk.
maxRetryLoopsPerBatch: Targeted retries; full verification loop capped
